title: Pope John Paul II: 'we are not alone'
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of Pope John Paul II: 'we are not alone', about 1994 at Vatican, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But back then, when I met the Roman Pope in 1994, I didn't quite understand it.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, described as a president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, says he met Pope John Paul II, then head of the Catholic Church, at the Vatican in 1994. He says the Pope conveyed that "we are not alone," and that he only understood what that meant later. If true, it would mean the Church's leader hinted at life beyond Earth.
